cases.name: original
cases.description: The product's schema as it ships: two defaults above their control's max (signup_page's padding, 120 and 130 over 96) and a version that is not semver.

cases.name: valid
cases.description: The base: valid, without a version 1 map.

cases.name: valid-v1-map
cases.description: The base with the product's version 1 map: valid.

cases.name: format
cases.description: A schema that is not in nodes stops at the format.

cases.name: semver
cases.description: A version of the base that is not major.minor.patch.

cases.name: product-type
cases.description: A product type that is not one of the Builder's.

cases.name: compile-not-a-node
cases.description: Values that are not nodes: the compiler's errors, without check(), and the version's.

cases.name: compile-token-type
cases.description: Tokens that do not declare the type or the options the engine validates them with.

cases.name: compile-kind
cases.description: A node whose type and scale are no property kind.

cases.name: own-colors-dropped
cases.description: A schema names its own colors: dropping one its components still paint is an alias error at each of them.

cases.name: own-colors-added
cases.description: A color of the catalog the schema adds, offered to the focus ring too: valid.

cases.name: tokens-required-unknown
cases.description: A token missing, one the format does not have, and a group it does not have.

cases.name: token-narrowed
cases.description: The focus ring offers some of its colors and distances, its default among them, and the scrollbar's tokens are dimensions: valid.

cases.name: token-narrowed-default
cases.description: A narrowed token whose default is not among its options.

cases.name: token-not-narrowable
cases.description: A token that may not be narrowed, and the focus ring's color narrowed to one of no catalog: the compiler's type errors.

cases.name: rules
cases.description: A custom typography, a string with a longest value and one with a pattern, and an image with a safe area: valid.

cases.name: alpha
cases.description: Colors the editor may make translucent, a token, a component's base and a variant's state: valid (the compiled schema lists them in `alpha`).

cases.name: rules-invalid
cases.description: Rules of another kind, a pattern no engine reads, and a default its rule refuses.

cases.name: rules-patterns
cases.description: Patterns of the subset PCRE and ECMAScript read alike, each with a default it takes: valid.

cases.name: rules-patterns-escapes
cases.description: Escapes outside the subset: whitespace, a PCRE anchor, a property, a character code and a backreference.

cases.name: rules-patterns-groups
cases.description: Groups outside the subset: a lookbehind, a named group, an inline flag, an atomic group and an unclosed one.

cases.name: rules-patterns-quantifiers
cases.description: Quantifiers outside the subset: possessive, with nothing to repeat, out of order, a brace that is no quantifier and over a lookahead.

cases.name: rules-patterns-classes
cases.description: Classes outside the subset: empty, empty and negated, a POSIX class, a word boundary inside and a `-` in the middle.

cases.name: rules-patterns-literals
cases.description: Literals and escapes outside the subset: a lone `]` and `}`, `\-` outside a class, a word boundary and a control character.

cases.name: rules-patterns-values
cases.description: Defaults a pattern of the subset refuses as ECMAScript does: before a final newline `$` does not match, `\d` is ASCII and `.` matches no line break.

cases.name: typography-line
cases.description: A line height in px, and one above the ratio the format takes: invalid typography defaults.

cases.name: tokens-values
cases.description: Token defaults that are not literals of their group's kind.

cases.name: prop-defaults
cases.description: Property defaults that do not fit their kind (one also above its control's max).

cases.name: prop-options
cases.description: Options a kind does not take, and a level the options leave out.

cases.name: prop-shape
cases.description: Nodes without a type: a value is no tuple (unless it looks like one), and an empty group of the site.

cases.name: unknown-section
cases.description: A section of a component that is none of the known ones.

cases.name: platforms
cases.description: A platform the schema does not declare, and platform properties that are not the base's of the same kind.

cases.name: scope
cases.description: A group's scope: what is no component, a group, itself, a property the component lacks, of another kind, a default that does not fit.

cases.name: slots
cases.description: Slots: an unknown component, an axis its component lacks, a choice it does not have, a group, and a component whose slots nest too deep.

cases.name: inherits
cases.description: Parents that do not exist, that inherit themselves, or that are the component.

cases.name: visibility-images
cases.description: Visibility and image defaults that do not fit, image formats and hints that are not valid.

cases.name: visibility-v1
cases.description: Version 1 paths of visibility and images that are not a string or null.

cases.name: follows
cases.description: What follows Identity with a group that is not the property's kind.

cases.name: derive
cases.description: Derived colors from a color the schema lacks, by an operation of the components, from a name that is no alias.

cases.name: component-derive
cases.description: Components' derivations by an operation of the colors, from a value the variant lacks, inset by one it lacks.

cases.name: matrix
cases.description: A matrix on a component without colors, and one into a section the component has.

cases.name: migrate-valid
cases.description: Migrations from keys the schema no longer has to keys it has.

cases.name: migrate-invalid
cases.description: Migrations from a key the schema has, to one it lacks, across sections and onto themselves.

cases.name: migrate-sections-valid
cases.description: Migrations of visibility, images and pages: a key whose own dots name no group, an image, a whole page, a page's footer, its list of sections, and one section within a page and to another.

cases.name: migrate-sections-invalid
cases.description: Migrations of visibility, images and pages it rejects: from a key the schema has, to an image it lacks, a visibility key into a page's section, a footer into a section, a section into a page, a page field it has not, a page's sections or a section the schema still has, and a path deeper than a section.

cases.name: migrate-own-colors
cases.description: Migrations read the schema's own colors, not the catalog: from a catalog color the schema does not name (as one it dropped) passes, to one fails.

cases.name: migrate-tokens
cases.description: Migrations of tokens by the schema's own names, of every group: a typography style and an opacity it does not name pass; from a group of tokens, a component's base or a variant the schema still has, it rejects.

cases.name: pages
cases.description: Pages: a field they do not have, a footer that is no bool, a section hidden that cannot be, a section twice, sections of another type, an empty page.

cases.name: pages-v1
cases.description: Sections' version 1 paths: one that is visibility's, one that is no `.hidden` path, a `v1_default` that is no bool, one that another section has.

cases.name: v1
cases.description: The version 1 map: paths that are not strings, an empty list, two controls on one key (in two entries, in one list, a site setting), and a path the schema lacks (left out).

cases.name: v1-own-colors
cases.description: The version 1 map names a catalog color the schema does not name: it is left out, so its key does not collide with the primary's.

cases.name: out-of-range
cases.description: Defaults outside their control's min and max, and nothing else.

cases.name: check-and-range
cases.description: A default that neither fits its kind nor its control: check()'s error, then outOfRange()'s.

cases.name: check-and-semver
cases.description: check()'s errors and the version's together.

cases.name: editor-valid
cases.description: Editor metadata the rules take: a visibility group shown in a page and one in a component, an ascending scale, a font control listing every font with its weights, a translucent color marked alpha, a typography group as wide as its levels and a text control with its placeholder.

cases.name: editor-alpha
cases.description: Colors the editor would show opaque (a translucent default, an alias to a token marked alpha), and alpha on a number and on a group.

cases.name: editor-platforms
cases.description: Platform defaults on a component property and on the visibility block, not on a key: visibility.<key>.platforms.invalid is check()'s.

cases.name: editor-pages
cases.description: Pages on a group of another section, a page the schema lacks, two groups of one key in a page, a visibility key in no group, one in two (a row and a card's switch), and a path that is no visibility key.

cases.name: editor-components
cases.description: Components on a group of another section, pages and components on one group, a component the schema lacks, two groups of one key in a component, and a card that lists what a visibility group already shows in its component.

cases.name: editor-card-order
cases.description: A component's props and cards out of order: a prop without order, two of one order in a card, a path the schema lacks, a card listing a prop before one of a lower order, a prop in a card it does not name, and one naming a card that does not list it.

cases.name: editor-rows
cases.description: A group of the editor whose rows go back to order 4 first, and a token listed by a group it does not name.

cases.name: editor-custom
cases.description: custom on a token, on a group, and false on a typography chosen by level in a component; on a property of another type it is check()'s rules.invalid alone.

cases.name: editor-limits
cases.description: Limits of the number controls: a typography field whose min is over its max and one under its default, a level with a unit and no max, and a min over the max (the default within them is outOfRange()'s).

cases.name: editor-lines
cases.description: Line height fields that are no ratio of the size (a unit of px, a max of 120), and a typography group narrower than its levels.

cases.name: editor-ordered
cases.description: Scales out of order: control heights said descending, and cards that list a color and a group.

cases.name: editor-section-groups
cases.description: The blocks of the pages: on a footer, missing on a page whose sections move in blocks, repeated, and in another order than the sections'.

cases.name: editor-fonts
cases.description: Weights on a select, and a font control that lists a font twice, one that is not its own, leaves out the rest, and gives weights that go down.

cases.name: editor-texts
cases.description: Rules of a string on a token and on a slot, a placeholder and multiline on controls that are no text; on another property they are check()'s rules.invalid.

cases.name: editor-page-sections
cases.description: A page's sections: one alone in its group, and a key that does not start with a letter.

cases.name: editor-visibility-type
cases.description: A visibility key typed string: its default is still a bool, which check() asks.

cases.name: version-equal
cases.description: The same version as the previous one.

cases.name: version-lower
cases.description: A version lower than the previous one of its base.

cases.name: version-previous-short
cases.description: A previous version of two parts (`26.0` is `26.0.0`): a patch over it.

cases.name: version-previous-prerelease
cases.description: A previous pre-release: PHP's version_compare() puts 26.1.0 after 26.1.0-beta.

cases.name: new-base
cases.description: A new base is not compared: it may remove anything; what it adds and deprecates is still reported.

cases.name: diff-patch-default
cases.description: A patch that changes a default.

cases.name: diff-patch-texts
cases.description: A patch that changes only texts and editor metadata.

cases.name: diff-minor-add
cases.description: A minor that adds keys (the visibility key in a group of the editor) and changes a default.

cases.name: diff-removed
cases.description: A minor that removes a key that was not deprecated.

cases.name: diff-removed-deprecated
cases.description: A minor that removes a deprecated key and a component deprecated as a whole.

cases.name: diff-deprecated-zero
cases.description: A key deprecated as the string "0" is not deprecated (PHP's empty()): removing it breaks.

cases.name: diff-deprecating
cases.description: A minor that deprecates keys: only the newly deprecated are reported.

cases.name: diff-migrated
cases.description: A minor that moves a key with a migration.

cases.name: diff-migrated-sections
cases.description: A minor that moves a visibility key, an image and a whole page with migrations: the page's footer and sections go with it.

info.default: Whether this page ends with the footer. The whole website’s choice is in Visibility.
Whether this page ends with the footer on phones.
This page has no sections to move or hide.

cases.name: diff-page-partly-migrated
cases.description: A minor that drops a page but moves only its footer: its sections are removed.

info.default: Whether this page ends with the footer. The whole website’s choice is in Visibility.
Whether this page ends with the footer on phones.
This page has no sections to move or hide.

cases.name: diff-type-changed
cases.description: A minor that changes the type of a key.

cases.name: diff-scale-changed
cases.description: A minor that moves dimensions to another scale: the levels stored themes name are of the old one.

cases.name: diff-option-removed
cases.description: A minor that removes an option (and adds another).

cases.name: diff-migration-removed
cases.description: A minor that drops a migration of its base.

cases.name: diff-errors
cases.description: Every incompatibility at once, in SchemaDiff's order: each key's, the migrations', and a patch's values.

cases.name: diff-valid-changes
cases.description: A valid minor with every kind of change: added, removed (deprecated), migrated and deprecated.

cases.name: upgrade-valid
cases.description: A new base whose block accounts for every key of the previous one: moves (a renamed property, a color, a visibility key, a whole page, a site setting, and two in place with a map, an option renamed and a scale changed), drops (a property whose type changed, a visibility key, a setting) and a rewrite.

info.default: Whether this page ends with the footer. The whole website’s choice is in Visibility.
Whether this page ends with the footer on phones.
This page has no sections to move or hide.

cases.name: upgrade-to-migrated
cases.description: A move to a key the new base's own migrations move on: it counts where they take it.

info.default: Whether this page ends with the footer. The whole website’s choice is in Visibility.
Whether this page ends with the footer on phones.
This page has no sections to move or hide.

cases.name: upgrade-required
cases.description: A new base without a block, though there is a previous one.

info.default: Whether this page ends with the footer. The whole website’s choice is in Visibility.
Whether this page ends with the footer on phones.
This page has no sections to move or hide.

cases.name: upgrade-from-not-previous
cases.description: A block whose `from` is not the previous base.

info.default: Whether this page ends with the footer. The whole website’s choice is in Visibility.
Whether this page ends with the footer on phones.
This page has no sections to move or hide.

cases.name: upgrade-from-not-lower
cases.description: A block whose `from` is not below its own base: nothing else is checked.

info.default: Whether this page ends with the footer. The whole website’s choice is in Visibility.
Whether this page ends with the footer on phones.
This page has no sections to move or hide.

cases.name: upgrade-errors
cases.description: Every error of a block at once, in order: a move from a key the previous base has not, to one the new base has not, across sections, with a map to what is no option or level, from a key an earlier move has; drops of what the previous base has not; and the keys nothing accounts for (a property whose type changed, a setting, a typography style, a visibility key).

info.default: Whether this page ends with the footer. The whole website’s choice is in Visibility.
Whether this page ends with the footer on phones.
This page has no sections to move or hide.

cases.name: upgrade-minor-adds
cases.description: A minor of the new base that adds a move and a path to drop: valid.

cases.name: upgrade-removed
cases.description: A minor of the new base that drops a move of its block, and one that changes its rewrite: schema.upgrade_removed.

cases.name: development-semver
cases.description: In development, the version is still semver.

cases.name: development-prop-defaults
cases.description: In development, the schema itself is still checked.

cases.name: development-version-equal
cases.description: In development, the same version as the previous one is no refusal: its changes are answered.

cases.name: development-version-lower
cases.description: In development, a version lower than the previous one is no refusal.

cases.name: development-diff-removed
cases.description: In development, removing a key that was not deprecated is no refusal: it is reported as removed.

cases.name: development-diff-errors
cases.description: In development, every incompatibility at once is no refusal: the changes are answered.

cases.name: development-diff-valid-changes
cases.description: In development, a valid minor answers the same changes.
